scope.normalization_status: explicit exact-n15 finite slice; not a universal-target consequence

case_axes.fresh: for arm=fresh, a first-interior label distinct from kept and deleted; for secondcap_*, a second-interior label

important_distinctions.critical_blocker_domain: all carrier labels except the source; apex labels remain in the syntactic one-hot domain, while tri-apex richness explicitly forces every apex's used-center literal false
important_distinctions.critical_row: full ambient positive-radius class of cardinality exactly four
important_distinctions.rich_class: full ambient positive-radius class with exact S6/D44 size
important_distinctions.packet_B1: chosen four-subset of a q-deleted apex class; off-subset incidence is unknown
important_distinctions.packet_B2: chosen subset identified with the retained source's full critical row by secondRow_support_eq_criticalShell_of_center_eq for every one-hot carrier blocker, including the rejected apex-center branch
important_distinctions.secondcap_endpoint_split: the Lean fresh continuation has fresh in the second strict cap; sourceReturn is impossible by cap disjointness, and the two remaining endpoint outcomes are represented by equality or inequality of the actual one-hot blockers of fresh and kept
important_distinctions.endpoint_critical_fiber: the named RowHit is witnessed by kept membership in the retained first-apex rich class, from which Lean selects a four-subpacket through kept
important_distinctions.unsat_core: family-level operational core; arm-specific role identities are compiled into packet construction, so it is not a modular theorem dependency graph
important_distinctions.cyclic_alternation_cut: redundant propagation cut compiled from the four banked two-center bisector-parity terminals; it is already implied by strict Kalmanson plus the named circle equalities
important_distinctions.squared_distance_relaxation: independent positive squared-distance variables; same-center equality is transported from unsquared distances, but no nonlinear s=d^2 equation is assumed
important_distinctions.four_point_squared_cnd: all three balanced conditional-negative inequalities for every four carrier labels, on the independent squared-distance variables
important_distinctions.same_shell_squared_superadditivity: for every angularly ordered rich-shell triple x<y<z at an extreme apex, s(x,z)>s(x,y)+s(y,z), normalized to margin one
important_distinctions.triple_center_multiplicity: for every distinct target triple, at most one of all fifteen carrier labels is equidistant from all three; the unsquared-distance predicate is unguarded because self-centers are excluded by zero versus positive distance
important_distinctions.critical_row_cross_cap_rich_slice_one_hi: if a used full critical-shell center is in strict cap i, its row meets each fixed rich radius slice in every distinct strict cap j in at most one point
important_distinctions.provenance_freeze: the parent captures source and artifact hashes once; the exact frozen map is serialized into the invocation, every worker result, and the final summary
important_distinctions.solver_unsat: external evidence for this finite abstraction, not a Lean proof
